locations.note: Akiyama, Majima, Ryuji Goda and Kiryu fight through a zombie outbreak sealed inside Kamurocho, the series' Kabukicho, ending atop the Millennium Tower against the mutated Nikaido.
A caller tells Kiryu at his Okinawa orphanage that Haruka has been kidnapped, drawing him back to Kamurocho.

routes.name: Into the quarantine zone
routes.note: From the first outbreak in Kamurocho to Kiryu's call in Okinawa and the climb up the Millennium Tower.
